listings.title: Keller Golf Club #15 Hole-in-One
description: A layered hole-in-one plaque for Keller's 15th, with a deep blue pond, mowing lines on the green and hand-placed trees.
Proof that an ace never gets old. This one went in on August 11, 1988. Any hole at any course can be made the same way, however long ago it happened.
photos: Layered wood hole-in-one plaque of Keller Golf Club hole 15 in a walnut frame, with a blue pond and raised trees

listings.title: Seville #14 Hole-in-One Plaque
listings.location: Seville Golf & Country Club · Gilbert, Arizona
description: A hole-in-one plaque for Seville's par-3 14th, with layered wood fairway and green, a dark green border, raised trees and the cart path engraved along the top.
The actual ball sits on two wooden pegs between engraved plates for the hole details and the ace: the golfer's name, the date, the club and the yardage. Shown here in a white frame and a black frame.
photos: Seville hole 14 hole-in-one plaque in a white frame with the ace ball mounted below the map
Seville hole 14 hole-in-one plaque in a black frame, 187 yards with a 6 iron, August 12, 2025

listings.title: Seville #17 Hole-in-One Plaque
listings.location: Seville Golf & Country Club · Gilbert, Arizona
description: Seville's island-green par 3, built in layers of wood with a glossy blue water hazard and raised trees.
Each plaque is engraved with the golfer's name, the date of the ace, the yardage and the club. These photos show plaques made for several different aces, including one golfer who has holed it twice.

listings.title: The Flying Wasp Sailboat Sign
description: A custom sign for the sailboat The Flying Wasp. The hull, mainsail and jib are cut from wood and painted white, with the panel lines engraved in. The mast, boom and deck are left in natural wood, and the rigging is engraved into the charcoal background.
The boat's name sits above in raised wood letters, and the whole piece is set in a gold frame.
